Stoop Chat

This demo pairs the two Stoop Net components:

  • <stoop-id> — asks for your display name and a password. The name is kept in local storage; the password is stretched into a signing key that never leaves your device.
  • <stoop-chat> — the neighborhood chat. Every message you send ends with a 7-character signature derived from your password, like a wax seal: Hello neighbors! #3f9a2c1.

This page runs in demo mode (the demo attribute), so messages stay in the browser and no radio is needed. Point a real Stoop node at this page by removing the attribute — the chat then talks to /api/* on the node.
